title: Cold-Chain Delivery Allowance on Specialty Transition Supplies (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Allowance.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a specialty transition supply of a refrigerated drug carries a cold-chain delivery allowance. The allowance depends on the cold-chain list of the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program and on where the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug was delivered:

| Drug on the program's cold-chain list | Latest shipped fill delivered to | Allowance added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the member's home | **2** days |
| yes | the prescriber's office | **1** day |
| yes | any other location | none |
| no | any location | none |

The allowance is added to the supply's dose-cycle days. Only after that is the supply held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

**Reading the records.** The cold-chain list belongs to the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program. The delivery location is the one shown on the latest shipped specialty fill of the drug, latest by ship date.

*Hypothetical.* Suppose a refrigerated biologic on the program's cold-chain list was last shipped to the prescriber's office, and the supply's dose-cycle days come to 14. The allowance is 1 day, which brings the supply to 15 days before the formulary maximum is applied. Had the fill gone to the member's home, the allowance would be 2 days, giving 16 days. For a drug not on the list, nothing is added wherever the fill went.
